svg.title: The toolbox — index, part 2: Data and Run
svg.desc: The toolbox — index, part 2 of 2, A–Z: every tool I ship with, and the work in this issue it appears in. Data (where state lives): Firebase — in MealMind (Fig. 9); PostgreSQL — in DualMind Arena (Fig. 2); Redis — in ModVigil (Fig. 6); Supabase — in DualMind Arena (Fig. 2) and AI Support Agent (Fig. 8). Run (cloud, edge, delivery): Azure; Chrome MV3 — in PixelProof (Fig. 5); Cloudflare — in DualMind Arena (Fig. 2) and Ratchet (Fig. 3); Devvit (Reddit) — in ModVigil (Fig. 6); Docker; GitHub Actions; Workers (Cloudflare) — in Ratchet (Fig. 3).
